```json
  {"metric": "iout_err_pct", "op": "<=", "value": 1.5},
  {"metric": "rout", "op": ">=", "value": 1.2e6},
  {"metric": "v_compliance", "op": "<=", "value": 0.16}
],
"topology": "self-biased wide-swing cascode NMOS sink mirror (series-R biased, weak inversion)",
"rationale": "A simple mirror cannot give 1.2 Mohm at 20 uA with a low Vdsat, so the output must be cascoded. A resistor R from iin to the mirror gate node biases the cascode gates IR above it. This sets the bottom devices to about 0.1 V Vds. With both pairs in weak inversion (gm/Id ~20-24), compliance is about Vds_b plus 2-3 UT, roughly 0.15 V. Rout is about gm_c*ro_c*ro_b, well above 1 Mohm. Equal Vds and L=1 keep the current error low."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # bottom mirror pair gm/Id
    "L_b":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # bottom pair L (matching, ro)
    "gmid_c": (22.0, 15.0, 25.0),     # cascode gm/Id (low Vdsat)
    "L_c":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),       # cascode L
    "vds_b":  (0.10, 0.07, 0.16),     # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec["iin"]
    vout = spec["vout_nom"]
    vdsb = p["vds_b"]

    # bottom mirror devices (identical, ratio 1)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], I, vds=vdsb, vsb=0.0)
    # cascode devices: source sits at vds_b, so include the body effect
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=max(vout - vdsb, 0.2), vsb=vdsb)

    # Self-bias: V(iin) = Vgs_b + I*R ; Vds_b = V(iin) - Vgs_c  ->  R
    R = (vdsb + mc.vgs - mb.vgs) / I
    R = max(R, 100.0)
    vds_b_act = mb.vgs + I * R - mc.vgs

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin -R- g (gate of bottom pair = drain of input cascode)
    n.R("R1", "iin", "g", R)
    n.dev("MC1", "g", "iin", "n1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MB1", "n1", "g", "vss", "vss", mb)
    # output branch
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "n2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MB2", "n2", "g", "vss", "vss", mb)

    # predictions
    rout = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / (mc.gds * mb.gds) + 1.0 / mc.gds
    # weak-inversion cascode needs ~2-3 UT across it to stay >=95%
    v_comp = vds_b_act + 2.5 * 0.0259
    # Vds of the bottom devices is nearly equal; the residual comes from the cascode's finite gain
    iout_err = 100.0 * (mb.gds * abs(vout - vds_b_act - (mb.vgs - vds_b_act)) /
                        (mc.gm / mc.gds) / I)
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": iout_err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": v_comp,
               "power": I * 2 * 1.8}
```
